explained.2: axis tick / combo digits of the Qt viewer
explained.blur: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.cividis: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView; not offered by the shared emtk ImageCanvas (report: more colormaps).
explained.divide: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.frame: Qt ImageView frame/time label of the normalisation
explained.gray: present in emtk's list (only shown when it is opened)
explained.inferno: present in emtk's list (only shown when it is opened)
explained.mean: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation (Operation: subtract/divide/blur of a frame range); display tool, not part of the analysis.
explained.roi: pyqtgraph ImageView ROI button: a line-profile ROI of the viewer; the emtk image has no ROI (the Detectors and the maps are the tool's function).
explained.subtract: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
explained.t: Qt ImageView axis label (frame index); the emtk movie has Play, Loop, Stop and a frame slider
explained.timerange: Qt ImageView time-range widgets of its normalisation
explained.viridis: Colormap names inside the Qt image's colormap menu; emtk offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray in the shared ImageCanvas (shared chisurf/emtk, not editable here).
explained.x: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
explained.y: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
